description.en-US: The embedded default is Amadeus's low-latency GPT-SoVITS runtime and accepts v1, v2, v2Pro, v2ProPlus, and v3 checkpoints. Remote audio enters the same playback, subtitle, AEC, and mouth-signal pipeline.
